title: Alignment Services & Plans — Cancellation Window and Refund Terms
content:
A plan of Alignment Services & Plans may be cancelled for a refund only inside its cancellation window, and cancelling is the holder's own decision: the agent registers the request and the holder confirms it.

## Conditions on the plan's records
- **Status.** The plan must be in status active when the cancellation is completed, as the plan's own system record shows.
- **Window.** The cancellation must be completed no later than the end of the cancellation window counted from the purchase of the plan. The clock starts on the plan's recorded purchase date. Calendar days are counted from the day after the anchor date, so the anchor date plus the number of days is the last qualifying date; a cancellation completed on that date qualifies. The window is the line's cancellation window in days.
- **No window.** A line whose window is 0 (a single service) is never cancelled, and after the window nothing is refunded.

## Refund amount — no longer in force
The clause that the refund is the purchase price less the line's deduction for each included alignment already performed (the purchase-day alignment included), never below 0.00, with alignments charged at the member early price and readjustments not deducted, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current settlement basis.

## Where the refund goes
The refund goes to the tender that paid for the plan.

## Window boundary (hypothetical plan with a 30-day window, bought on day D)
| Completed on | Inside the window? |
|---|---|
| day D plus 1 | Yes — counting starts the day after purchase |
| day D plus 30 | Yes — the last qualifying date |
| day D plus 31 | No — nothing is refunded |

superseded_clauses: The refund is purchase_price minus used_alignment_deduction for each included alignment already performed (alignment_msr_included_alignments, the purchase-day alignment included), never below 0.00; alignments charged at the member early price and readjustments are not deducted.
